name: 1-cover.jpg
note: The cover: northbound on the beach avenue, the promenade and the sea below, palms, café and hotel signs, traffic in both lanes, 27 on the speedo.

name: 2-onfoot.jpg
note: On foot on a downtown pavement: the gold job marker lit on the pawn shop door, pedestrians and parked traffic, health and armour bars up.

name: 3-police.jpg
note: Three stars at a junction: a cruiser nosing in from the north, a second broadside to the east, three officers out with pistols drawn, tracers and skids on the asphalt.

name: 4-mission.jpg
note: Counter Service in progress: Sunstate Bank lit blue, teller and guard inside, getaway car at the kerb, objective and wanted banner on the HUD.
